cards.title: Midterm Elections Could Reshape AI Industry
cards.body: Democrats' historic midterm victories may transform the tech industry as voters overwhelmingly restricted data center development. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures, with all but one imposing stricter regulations.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls Despite Rising Usage
cards.body: AI usage continues climbing but spending has plateaued as major enterprises implement smarter cost controls. Price cuts from providers could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

cards.title: Amazon Launches Text-to-Shop Alexa Feature
cards.body: Amazon has enabled users to text Alexa for shopping assistance. The feature rolls out to millions of users in coming weeks.

cards.title: Underdog Demos Tiny 32MB Speech Model
cards.body: Despite its minimal size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music. The breakthrough challenges assumptions about model efficiency requirements.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Sim-to-Real
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to solve the sim-to-real gap for robotics. The startup uses a pipeline originally built for e-commerce product marketing.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Eyes Clutch Acquisition
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for $500 million. Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million.

cards.title: Airbnb Launching AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb will launch an AI travel agent in H1 2027 to help users plan trips and manage bookings. The agent will provide assistance throughout travelers' stays.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Avatar Now Video Calls
cards.body: Meta's AI agent can now accept video calls as a customizable animated avatar. The feature precedes the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable for Muse.

cards.title: Meta Warns Data Center Opposition Threatens AI
cards.body: Meta warns that political backlash against data centers could impede future AI expansion. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive infrastructure projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity Model
cards.body: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model amid industry scrutiny over AI lab contributions to digital infrastructure protection. The release underscores growing security concerns.

cards.title: OpenAI Could Be IPO Ready in 2027
cards.body: OpenAI President Greg Brockman stated the company could be IPO-ready in 2027. The executive highlighted gains in the enterprise market, where Anthropic has also expanded.

cards.title: Claude Adds Personal Finance Analysis Tool
cards.body: Anthropic launched Personal Finance in Claude, allowing users to connect bank accounts via Plaid for financial analysis. Users can now ask questions about their spending and accounts.

cards.title: Axiom Math Battles AI Slop in Mathematics
cards.body: Axiom Math is tackling unverified AI math proofs by using AI agents for formal verification. The startup formally verified the Stacks Project, one of mathematics' largest libraries.

cards.title: Dropbox Acquires Tigris Data for $350M
cards.body: Dropbox acquired Tigris Data for $350 million to strengthen its AI infrastructure capabilities. The deal supports development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform for AI developers.

cards.title: Aina Smart Ring Offers Screen and Joystick
cards.body: Aina released a smart ring with a screen, joystick, and mic for AI agent interaction. The device also enables calls and Mac note dictation.

cards.title: Box Partners With Nvidia for Content Retrieval
cards.body: Box integrated Nvidia's Nemotron for a new agent-first content retrieval system. The system delivers four times faster queries with 20% fewer errors and 90% token reduction.

cards.title: YC Startup Funds AI Materials Science Research
cards.body: A Y Combinator startup is committing $1 million to solve five unsolved materials science problems using AI. Frontier AI models have excelled at math and life sciences but lag in materials physics.

cards.title: Agility Becomes First Public Humanoid Robot
cards.body: Agility became the first pure-play humanoid robotics company to go public, listing on Nasdaq today. The milestone marks significant growth for the humanoid robotics sector.

cards.title: Apple Cuts Internal AI Usage Budgets
cards.body: Apple is reducing budgets for internal AI use as token costs accumulate. The move reflects broader industry trends toward token rationing over unlimited spending.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Launches in SF
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into robotics' practical future. The technology demonstrates AI-powered automation moving beyond labs into everyday household tasks.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom at Risk
cards.body: Texas has been ground zero for major AI data center buildouts, but recent political shifts may jeopardize its position as the fastest-growing data center market. Energy policy changes could impact the state's AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Controls Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach using reverse game theory aims to keep AI agents in check by designing constraints into their behavior. The method addresses growing challenges in managing autonomous AI systems.

cards.title: AI Agents in Enterprise Need Data Lineage Security
cards.body: Enterprise AI agents pulling data from multiple sources create security risks when outputs are used by other agents. Proper data lineage protocols are essential for preventing compromised AI-generated proposals.

cards.title: Google Makes AI Search Non-Negotiable for Schools
cards.body: Google is requiring schools to adopt its AI search capabilities even if they skip other Gemini features. The move signals Google's commitment to integrating AI into educational search infrastructure.

cards.title: ChatGPT Used to Plan Murder in Lawsuit
cards.body: A lawsuit alleges a woman used ChatGPT to plan her husband's murder after he introduced her to the AI tool. The case highlights emerging legal and safety concerns around AI chatbot misuse.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress Over China
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces Congressional scrutiny regarding Chinese espionage concerns related to AI chip technology. The hearing reflects ongoing government focus on AI semiconductor security.

cards.title: NASA Uses AI-Generated Image for X-70 Aircraft
cards.body: NASA unveiled its mysterious experimental X-70 aircraft using an AI-generated image in promotional materials. The move demonstrates government adoption of generative AI for aerospace visualization.
